items.title: Samsung Electronics To Implement Largest-Ever Shareholder Return in 2026, Estimated at KRW 90 to 110 Trillion
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics’ Board of Directors convened today and approved a shareholder return plan for 2026, estimated at approximately KRW 90 trillion to KRW 110 trillion. This is approximately five times the size of the previous record of KRW 20.3 trillion, set in 2020 and marks the largest ever by a Korean company. The record-breaking shareholder return is […]

items.title: Samsung’s Human-Centered Design Wins IDEA and Red Dot Design Award 2026
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics today announced that it has received significant honors at the International Design Excellence Awards (IDEA) 2026 and the Red Dot Design Award 2026.
